contrastWaivers.light: text.on-brand on bg.brand: 3.44:1. White on Pampas 500 is the core colourway in the Figma (Final Design). It passes 3:1 for large text and UI parts, not 4.5:1 for normal text. Limit it to logos and text at 24px+ or 18.66px bold. Buttons use Pampas 700.
